quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a continuous glucose monitor designed for people without diabetes who want to optimise energy.
quests.correctAnswer: See exactly how each meal affects your energy in real time - no blood test required.
quests.hint: Reframe clinical technology for an everyday wellness audience.
quests.explanation: Repositioning medical technology for everyday wellness reaches far more people than treating patients alone.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a wearable device that detects early dehydration before you feel thirsty.
quests.correctAnswer: It senses low hydration before thirst even kicks in, so tiredness never catches you off guard.
quests.hint: Lead with the early warning, before any symptom appears.
quests.explanation: Catching a problem before it's even noticed is one of the most persuasive angles in health tech.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a home blood pressure monitor that sends readings straight to your doctor.
quests.correctAnswer: Every reading goes straight to your doctor, so your care team stays informed with zero extra appointments.
quests.hint: Highlight the seamless link to clinical care.
quests.explanation: Removing an entire appointment from the process is a saving both patients and doctors value.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a daily personalised vitamin pack delivered in single-dose sachets based on your blood test.
quests.correctAnswer: Your blood test decides exactly what goes in each daily sachet - no more guessing at the pharmacy shelf.
quests.hint: Contrast the personalised pack with guessing in a shop.
quests.explanation: Contrasting precision with guesswork makes a science-backed product easy to justify buying.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a travel journal app that automatically builds a map of every place you visit.
quests.correctAnswer: Just take photos as you travel - the app quietly builds a beautiful map of your whole trip.
quests.hint: Focus on how little effort the traveller has to put in.
quests.explanation: Turning an existing habit, taking photos, into a finished souvenir feels like a free bonus.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a rental platform that provides baby gear so travelling parents don't have to pack it.
quests.correctAnswer: A crib and stroller are waiting at your destination, so parents can finally pack light again.
quests.hint: Picture the exact items parents dread packing.
quests.explanation: Naming the specific bulky items removes makes the relief for travelling parents instantly real.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart gym mirror that streams live fitness classes and corrects your form using AI.
quests.correctAnswer: Stream a live class and get real-time form corrections - a gym and a trainer in one mirror.
quests.hint: Highlight the real-time correction as the standout feature.
quests.explanation: Real-time correction is the missing piece that makes home workouts feel as effective as the gym.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a recovery app for athletes that tracks sleep, training, and nutrition together.
quests.correctAnswer: It combines your sleep, training load, and meals to tell you exactly when your body is ready to perform.
quests.hint: Focus on the single readiness answer it gives.
quests.explanation: Turning three data streams into one clear answer is what makes complex data genuinely useful.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a lost-and-found app that reunites travellers with items left behind at the airport.
quests.correctAnswer: Report it missing, and the app matches it against everything found at the airport that day.
quests.hint: Focus on the fast match, not the search process.
quests.explanation: Speed matters most in a lost-item pitch, since every hour raises the traveller's stress.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that sends pre-portioned spice blends matched to a different world cuisine each week.
quests.correctAnswer: Every week brings a new cuisine's exact spice blend, so weeknight dinners never taste the same twice.
quests.hint: Lead with the variety, not just the spices themselves.
quests.explanation: Promising variety solves the real boredom problem that makes people stop cooking at home.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a posture-tracking wearable that gently buzzes when you slouch at your desk.
quests.correctAnswer: A gentle buzz on your shoulder is the only reminder you'll ever need to sit up straight.
quests.hint: Keep the correction feeling gentle, not like a scolding.
quests.explanation: A gentle, non-judgemental correction feels supportive rather than nagging, which keeps people using it.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a loyalty app that combines every local shop's stamp card into a single phone screen.
quests.correctAnswer: Every paper stamp card in your wallet becomes one simple screen on your phone.
quests.hint: Contrast the clutter of paper cards with a single screen.
quests.explanation: A clutter-to-simplicity contrast is instantly understood by anyone who has ever lost a stamp card.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family calendar app that automatically colour-codes each member's activities across every device.
quests.correctAnswer: Everyone's plans land in one calendar, colour-coded by person, so no clash ever slips through again.
quests.hint: Focus on the family clash this app prevents.
quests.explanation: Naming the exact family problem - a missed clash - makes an ordinary calendar feel essential.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a size-matching app that predicts your correct fit across different clothing brands.
quests.correctAnswer: Enter your size once, and it tells you the right fit at every single brand you shop.
quests.hint: Highlight the end of returns, not just the sizing.
quests.explanation: Solving the return-because-it-didn't-fit problem speaks directly to a shared shopping frustration.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a hearing-support app that quietly amplifies conversation in noisy restaurants through earphones.
quests.correctAnswer: Slip in your earphones, and the voice across the table finally rises above the restaurant noise.
quests.hint: Picture the exact noisy moment this solves.
quests.explanation: A single vivid moment - a noisy dinner - makes an unfamiliar product feel immediately useful.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an electric toothbrush that tracks brushing coverage and shows missed spots on your phone.
quests.correctAnswer: It maps every brush stroke and shows exactly which spot you keep missing.
quests.hint: Focus on the one missed spot, not the whole mouth.
quests.explanation: A single specific detail - the missed spot - is more convincing than a general health claim.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a carry-on suitcase with a built-in compartment that clears airport security without unpacking.
quests.correctAnswer: Laptops and liquids stay packed - this case is built to glide straight through security.
quests.hint: Picture the security line as the exact moment this helps.
quests.explanation: A frustrating, universal moment - the security line - makes the benefit instantly relatable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a teeth whitening kit calibrated to match your natural enamel shade.
quests.correctAnswer: It whitens to your own natural shade, so results look bright but never artificial.
quests.hint: Lead with a natural-looking result, not raw whiteness.
quests.explanation: Addressing the fear of looking artificially over-whitened removes the main hesitation buyers have.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch smart glasses that automatically adjust their tint based on the light conditions around you.
quests.correctAnswer: They darken outdoors and clear up indoors automatically, so one pair now handles every light.
quests.hint: Highlight the effortless switch between indoor and outdoor light.
quests.explanation: Ending the need to swap glasses is an immediate, obvious convenience for any wearer.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription toy-rotation service that swaps your child's toys every month to reduce clutter.
quests.correctAnswer: Toys rotate every month, so your child always has something 'new,' and your house stays clutter-free.
quests.hint: Balance the child's excitement with the parent's tidy home.
quests.explanation: Solving one problem for the child and another for the parent doubles the pitch's appeal.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a blue light filter screen protector designed specifically for remote workers.
quests.correctAnswer: It blocks the blue light behind tired, aching eyes, so a full workday feels lighter.
quests.hint: Name the specific discomfort - tired eyes - remote workers feel by mid-afternoon.
quests.explanation: Naming a familiar mid-afternoon discomfort makes an invisible problem feel worth solving.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI skincare advisor that analyses your skin from a single selfie.
quests.correctAnswer: One selfie is all it takes to get a skincare routine built for your actual skin.
quests.hint: Lead with the speed of the selfie-based diagnosis.
quests.explanation: Speed plus personalisation removes the guesswork that usually makes skincare shopping so frustrating.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a picnic and day-trip planning app that suggests spots based on weather and crowd levels.
quests.correctAnswer: It checks the weather and the crowds, then sends you to the best spot before anyone else arrives.
quests.hint: Focus on beating the crowd, not just picking a location.
quests.explanation: Promising to beat the crowd adds urgency and fun to an otherwise simple planning task.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a refillable skincare system that cuts plastic packaging by ninety per cent.
quests.correctAnswer: The formula stays premium, but the plastic drops by ninety per cent - skincare you feel good buying.
quests.hint: Defend the quality before mentioning the packaging change.
quests.explanation: Reassuring people on quality first removes the doubt that eco-friendly must mean lower quality.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a portable air quality monitor for people living in polluted cities.
quests.correctAnswer: Carry it anywhere, and it warns you the moment the air around you turns unsafe to breathe.
quests.hint: Lead with the real-time personal warning.
quests.explanation: Turning invisible pollution into a clear, personal warning makes the risk feel real enough to act on.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family recipe box that turns handwritten grandparent recipes into a shareable digital cookbook.
quests.correctAnswer: Photograph grandma's handwritten recipes once, and the whole family can cook from them forever.
quests.hint: Focus on preserving something that could otherwise be lost.
quests.explanation: Preventing the loss of a family memory gives an ordinary app real emotional weight.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch invisible nasal filters that block allergens during high pollen season.
quests.correctAnswer: They block nearly all pollen and stay completely invisible - protection with none of the social awkwardness of a mask.
quests.hint: Lead with invisibility as much as the protection itself.
quests.explanation: Removing social awkwardness is often what finally convinces someone to try any wearable protection.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital health passport storing your complete medical records in one secure app.
quests.correctAnswer: Your full medical history travels with you, ready to share with any doctor, anywhere, instantly.
quests.hint: Highlight the global reach and the instant sharing.
quests.explanation: Instant access anywhere in the world matters more than ever as people travel and switch clinics.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a gift-tracking app that quietly remembers what you've already given each friend and family member.
quests.correctAnswer: It remembers every gift you've ever given, so you never repeat one by accident again.
quests.hint: Name the small but real embarrassment this prevents.
quests.explanation: Preventing a small, believable embarrassment is a light, memorable hook for a simple app.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a medication reminder app that checks new prescriptions against your current medicines for dangerous interactions.
quests.correctAnswer: Every new prescription is checked against what you already take, catching a dangerous mix before you swallow it.
quests.hint: Stress prevention happening before any harm occurs.
quests.explanation: Preventing harm before it happens is a safety pitch that needs no further justification.
